user_query: I'm organizing a family reunion and I need to find a suitable location for the event. Can you recommend some cities or countries with beautiful natural landscapes and enough accommodation options for a large group? Additionally, provide us with the geocode information and localized names of these places.

TaskList.description: Research and compile a list of cities or countries known for beautiful natural landscapes and suitable for large group accommodations.
Cross-reference the list of places to ensure they have sufficient accommodation options for large groups.
Use geocoding API to obtain geocode information for the recommended locations.
Fetch the localized names of the cities or countries from the geographical data.
